title: I built a full browser brawler with AI: Claude wrote the GDScript, Gemini painted the art. Here’s the free demo and what worked
author: tooavg
selftext:
**Bonkwood** is a cozy forest brawler (Brawlhalla-style combat + Helmet Heroes-style loot) made in Godot 4. It’s playable for free in the browser: [https://vestom.itch.io/bonkwood](https://vestom.itch.io/bonkwood)

Bonkwood is a 2D forest brawler built in Godot 4: Brawlhalla-style combat with Helmet Heroes-style loot and progression. The demo has 5 maps, 5 bosses, 7 weapons and 3 talent trees.

I designed the game and directed the development. Claude wrote the GDScript, and Gemini produced the art, which I processed into the game’s style with my own Python pipeline. All the balancing lives in data files, so iterating on bosses and weapons is fast.

The core idea: every boss drops its own helmet, and wearing it gives you that boss’s signature move. Beat the Canopy King and you can call down his coconut barrage yourself.

Free, runs in the browser: [https://vestom.itch.io/bonkwood](https://vestom.itch.io/bonkwood)

Feedback on the combat feel is especially welcome.
